compiled_state.description:
## Context

scripts/check_docs_index.py currently enforces top-level docs index membership and checks relative Markdown links only when their resolved target remains under docs. tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py carries a second parser for links that leave docs. F07 replaces that split with one deterministic repository-relative link checker over an explicit maintained-documentation boundary.

## Historical basis

Ticket mucky-like-elkhound deliberately limited its front-door remediation to top-level docs membership and links under docs. It was not intended as a site-wide linter. A dead outbound link was later repaired under illadvised-ropeable-huemul and protected by a separate unit-test parser. F07 absorbs that regression coverage without expanding into prompts, fixtures, anchor validation, external URL checks, or prose analysis.

## Source boundary

Include root Markdown files and Markdown under .agents, .github, docs, examples/agent-skills, infra runbooks, infra README files, scripts README files, src/rebar/_guides, src/rebar/llm/eval_specs, templates, tests/external README files, and tests/unit/fixtures/README.md. Exclude .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, src/rebar/llm/reviewers, tests/fixtures, tests/scripts/fixtures, tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/integration_gates, hidden root Markdown files, and local Markdown files. An excluded source may remain a valid link target.

## Parser contract

Retain top-level docs index membership as a separate rule. Scan inline Markdown links and images outside fenced blocks and inline code spans. Resolve each relative target from its source directory. Permit targets anywhere inside the repository. Reject targets that escape the repository. Strip query strings and fragments before file resolution. Ignore fragment-only and scheme-qualified targets. Do not validate heading anchors, external URL availability, reference-style links, HTML links, or bare path mentions. Sort sources and findings. Report the repository-relative source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason.

Document this source and parser boundary in docs/documentation-policy.md. Replace the script module text about a stub and held-out development history with current behavior. Keep the existing CI action because both CI routes already invoke this checker.

## Exclusions

- No audience classification, canonical-source inference, prose validation, or protected-content rewrite.
- No link correction is currently required. The surveyed boundary contains no broken active Markdown target.
- No docs/README.md, docs/generated-artifacts.md, workflow, prompt, fixture, or historical evidence edit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The checker retains every existing top-level docs index-membership behavior.
- [ ] The checker includes every declared source pattern and excludes every declared source exclusion.
- [ ] An excluded Markdown source may resolve as a valid target from an included source.
- [ ] Relative links and images resolve from their source directories to any target inside the repository.
- [ ] A missing target and a target that escapes the repository each produce a deterministic finding with source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason.
- [ ] Scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced blocks, and inline code spans produce no findings.
- [ ] Query strings and fragments are removed before file resolution.
- [ ] The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve is replaced with the checker API.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md states the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions.
- [ ] The assembled repository indexes the F01 pages and passes scripts/check_docs_index.py --check.
- [ ] tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py, tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py, the documentation parity test, make lint, make typecheck, and the project test gate pass.
